```plato
    //==
    // # IDifferentiableVectorField2D
    //
    // A planar vector field with first derivatives: divergence (trace of the
    // Jacobian) and scalar curl. The predicates classify local flow behaviour.

    // True where the field neither expands nor compresses within tolerance
    // (divergence-free / incompressible flow)
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Incompressible_flow).
    IsIncompressibleAt(self: IDifferentiableVectorField2D, point: Point2D, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.DivergenceAt(point).Abs <= tolerance;
```

## Line 252

```plato

    //==
    // # IDifferentiableVectorField3D
    //
    // A spatial vector field with first derivatives: divergence and the curl
    // vector (vorticity). Mirrors the planar classifiers with a vector curl.

    // True where the field neither expands nor compresses within tolerance
    // (divergence-free / incompressible flow).
    IsIncompressibleAt(self: IDifferentiableVectorField3D, point: Point3D, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.DivergenceAt(point).Abs <= tolerance;
```
